prompt_md: A book's pages are numbered 1 to 100, printed on both sides of every sheet. How many sheets of paper are in the book?
prompt_short: Pages 1 to 100, printed on both sides. How many sheets?
hint_md: Every sheet has a front and a back.
explain_intuition_md: Pages 1 and 2 are the two sides of one sheet, pages 3 and 4 the next, and so on. 100 pages fit on 50 sheets.
